purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt) management system - specifically the receipt search/correction screen (H99) for the JMA ORCA medical billing system
purpose.summary: This program implements the receipt search and manual correction screen (H99) of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software. It handles initialization, screen navigation, data entry, and database lookup for medical insurance claims (seikyu) associated with a patient. It interacts with system management master tables and patient public expense information.

notable_features: MCP framework linkage (MCP-STATUS, MCP-EVENT, MCP-WIDGET, MCP-PUTTYPE, MCP-WINDOW) - ORCA-specific screen/event model
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for event-driven screen handling
PERFORM-heavy structure with 67 PERFORMs and 13 GOTOs
Database access via MCP abstraction layer (900-DBSELECT-SEC, 900-SEIKYU-READ-SEC)
OCCURS tables for receipt list display
verdict.notes: Comments are in Japanese EUC encoding, decoded as latin-1 resulting in garbled characters. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Program name ORCGH99 suggests it is the H99 screen handler within the claims management (seikyu kanri) subsystem. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 51548 bytes total.
